articles.summary: The Versive Assistant and AI apps now plan a study with you and check it before you share it. AI apps can also run simulations, create participant links, and open interview recordings, and admins can turn off downloads of uploaded files.
articles.title: What's new: plan and check studies in chat, recordings in AI apps, and more

articles.summary: Choose the text, primary, and background colors participants see, match the app you embed a study in, and give every new study your colors, languages, and response limit.
articles.title: Introducing study colors and defaults: every new study starts on brand

articles.summary: Add a page before your first question with setup tips, a microphone test, what the answer timer means, and what to do if something goes wrong.
articles.title: Introducing the tutorial page: get participants set up before the first question

articles.summary: Turn on an AI follow-up on a closed question, and the interviewer asks why after the participant answers, so the score and the reason stay together in your results.
articles.title: Introducing AI follow-ups: hear the reason behind every closed answer
